business_problem: Asteria wanted to reduce the manual effort banks spend advising SME customers on loans and product options because relationship staff had to perform costly, time-consuming individualized analysis before recommending the right financial services.
solution_summary: Asteria used IBM's FintechX program to prototype a banking advisor that combines conversational AI, retrieval, and generative summarization. In a four-week MVP pilot, Asteria built the Asteria Smart Finance Advisor with IBM watsonx Assistant as the front end, IBM Watson Discovery for data querying, and IBM watsonx.ai for summarization and content generation. The advisor is designed to sit inside each bank's online portal, prompt SME users with updates about business health such as overdrafts or low cash balances, answer questions, and recommend relevant products. Behind the scenes, the system pulls customer and product context through Discovery and uses watsonx.ai to automate profile analysis and recommendation logic that had previously required manual advisor effort. The pilot showed that the early loan-advisory steps could be largely automated while preserving a path for bankers to focus on higher-value relationship work.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Provides the conversational front end for the Asteria Smart Finance Advisor inside bank portals.

solution_components.name: IBM Watson Discovery
solution_components.role: Queries the data sources that support customer-specific product and advisory responses.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Generates summaries and recommendations that automate parts of SME profile analysis and product matching.

data_flow: SME financial context and bank product information are queried through Watson Discovery, watsonx.ai generates summaries and recommendations, and watsonx Assistant presents the insights in a portal-based advisor that can answer questions and suggest next-best products.
business_outcome: Asteria showed that gen AI could automate the most time-intensive steps of SME financial advisory, reduce advisory effort, and help partner banks market relevant services with a more personalized digital experience.
metrics: 33% reduction in time spent on loan application advisory process
